snippet.title: Rocket League® — MLB Fan Pack Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Ball! The MLB Fan Pack comes to Rocket League March 25. Customize your Battle-Car with baseball cap Toppers, Flags, and Player Banners for all 30 MLB teams. The Fan Pack also includes a Baseball Rocket Boost, and an MLB-branded Flag and Player Banner. Learn more at https://www.RocketLeague.com/game-info/mlb/.
